$description: Thinking Raven design tokens (W3C design-tokens format). Source of truth for colour and type.

ink.$description: Raven ink. Primary dark: text on light, dark backgrounds.

bone.$description: Bone. Primary light: text on dark, light backgrounds.

amber.$description: Thought amber. Accent: the full stop, highlights, one call to action. Never text on light backgrounds (1.7:1).

wordmark.$description: "thinking" at 400 + "raven" at 700, lowercase, tracking -0.03em, followed by an amber full stop. Always use the outlined SVG, never retype it.
